newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska CEO to become chairman - paper.
newsitem.headline: Skanska CEO to become chairman - paper.

text.p: - Melker Schorling, the chief executive of Swedish construction company Skanska, will take over as chairman of the group, daily Svenska Dagbladet reported on Monday.
Schorling will replace Percy Barnevik who will step down to take control of Investor, the powerful Wallenberg family's key investment vehicle, sources told the newspaper.
The decision was preceded by talks between the three groups controlling Skanska -- investment companies Custos and Industrivarden and banking group Handelsbanken, Svenska Dagbladet said.

"Percy Barnevik showed his virtually unlimited influence on the Swedish business community when he ensured that Skanska's chief executive Melker Schorling will replace Barnevik as chairman of the construction group," the newspaper said.

The power struggle has spilled over to Custos and it looks as if the company's chairman Marcus Storch, the former chief executive of medical and technical gas group AGA, will have to step down after losing the Skanska fight, the daily added.
